shared_scope_en: Use the relevant ABC itinerary or corridor reference separately. The six-day pilot covers recorded stage observations, qualified equipment and preparation guidance, seasonal context and 1993–2022 ERA5 historical grid summaries. Preserve each observation's limits and units. Exact distances, unconfirmed pickup arrangements, unreviewed stage loads and live conditions need additional evidence. Give general preparation education only and clarify time or experience when relevant. Do not infer personal fitness clearance or a verified five-day variant.

dynamic_verification_rules.S06: Match the forecast point and elevation to the relevant stage, and verify that the forecast covers the intended walking period.
dynamic_verification_rules.S07: Verify the issuer, exact trail section, subject of the restriction or observation, and period of validity for each notice or field report.
